table.name: TLGNC_TRUCK
table.description: Trucks are used to deliver road orders and are owned by a carrier. Trucks can have 2-5 axes (having a loading capacity itself) or be of the type semi-trailer truck, where the trailer defines the loading capacity. Many of the fields have only informative character and are ignored by Logon.

column.name: CARRIER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_carrier. The carrier (in German: Transporteur, Spediteur, Lieferant) who owns the truck.

column.name: DISPATCHING_CARRIER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_carrier. FIXME

column.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
column.description: 0=inactive/deleted, 1=active.

column.name: PRIORITY
column.description: Range: 1-100. Used for ordering of the trucks. Value 100 means, that the truck is inactive. At the moment only used for ordering purposes. (later, i.e. at the moment out of scope, then also for the auto-scheduling functionality).

column.name: TRUCK_NAME
column.description: Name (ID) of the truck as displayed in the UI, with formatting. This is typically a shortened form of carrier + some enumeration, but must also be unique because it's used for display/selection in Logon. Example: Ernst 01.

column.name: TRUCK_PLATE_NO
column.description: Text on the number plate of the truck. Serves as alternative identifier for a truck, and must therefore be unique.

column.name: SAP_VEHICLE_NO
column.description: SAP Number of the truck. Field is going to be used in export interfaces to SAP.

column.name: TRUCK_TRANSPORT_CAT_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_truck_transport_cat_bs. E.g. Silo, Container, Auflieger. Logic: Silo -> Bulk transport, trailer and container need to be null. Container: Container transport, trailer needs to be null, container needs to be set. Trailer: Trailer needs to be set, container is null, TRUCK_TYPE_CD needs to be semi-trailer.

column.name: TRUCK_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK TLGNR_TRUCK_TYPE_BS. Type of the truck: 2-axle ... 5-axle truck or semi-trailer truck.

column.name: MANUFACTURER
column.description: Manufacturer of the truck. Has only informative character for the carrier and is ignored by Logon.

column.name: AXIS_COUNT
column.description: Number of axis of the truck. Has only informative character for the carrier and is ignored by Logon. No consistency check with TRUCK_TYPE_CD. User is free to enter 3+3 to describe truck+trailer compositions.

column.name: EURO_NORM
column.description: Euro Norm for this truck. Has only informative character for the carrier and is ignored by Logon.

column.name: MAX_GROSS_WEIGHT_T
column.description: Maximal gross weight (truck+load). This is the legal max weight for the truck (e.g. because of brake power), and is sent to parallel as the limit for 'load a full truck'. For a truck of type 'semi-trailer truck' (=trsp_cat_cd: Trailer), truck.max_gross_weight_t is irrelevant to Logon and tlgnc_trailer.max_gross_weight_t is used instead! The max_net_weight_chamber1/2_t cannot be used as a limit, they are just hints for the dispatcher.

column.name: TARE_WEIGHT_T
column.description: Weight of the empty truck in tons. Typically this is measured in steps of 10kg. This can differ quite a bit from the measured tare_weight of the truck because of the amount of petrol the truck has in its tank (400 liters...)!

column.name: HAS_DUSTFILTER_FLAG
column.description: 0=no dust filter, 1=truck has a dust filter, null=unkown/does not matter. Has only informative character for the carrier and is ignored by Logon.

column.name: VOLUME_M3
column.description: Loading volume of the truck in cubic meters. If the truck is of type semi-trailer it doesn't have a loading capacity on its own (just the one of the trailer). Logon does not have any logic attached to this volume; it is never the limiting factor for a load. This is in contrast to rail wagons, where the load limit can be either volume or weight, depending on the material density.

column.name: BRANDING_FLAG
column.description: 0=no, 1=yes, null=unkown/does not matter. Has only informative character for the carrier and is ignored by Logon.

column.name: NR_CHAMBERS
column.description: Number of chambers. For silo trucks 1 or 2, 0 for other truck types.

column.name: MAX_NET_WEIGHT_CHAMBER1_T
column.description: For silo and trailer transport type trucks only. Maximal net weight chamber 1. Defaults to MAX_GROSS_WEIGHT_T - TARA_WEIGHT_T. Set to 0 if not a silo truck. There is no logic/limitation bound to the max_net_weight_chamber1/2, it is for informational purposes only in Disposition. Most silo trucks actually have two chambers, and 3 loading openings: front, both, back.

column.name: MAX_NET_WEIGHT_CHAMBER2_T
column.description: For silo and trailer transport type trucks only. Maximal net weight chamber 2 (0, if truck has only one chamber or is a silo truck).

column.name: SAP_VEHICLE_IS_INTERNAL_FLAG
column.description: Internal means owned by Crh company => relevant for costs calculation in SAP Yes/no/Null not applicable. Copied value from tlgns_sap_vehicle.

column.name: SAP_VEHICLE_CHAR_CD
column.description: FK to tlgnr_sap_vehicle_char_bs. Truck characteristic.

column.name: SAP_VEHICLE_TYPE_CD
column.description: NULL for generic trucks for planning. Copied value from tlgns_sap_vehicle. SAP_TRAILER_TYPE_CD at the time of last update/creation.

column.name: PDA_AVAILABLE_FLAG
column.description: True, if a PDA is available for this truck. If false, information such as container/current trailer is manually edited by the disponent.

column.name: SMS_SEND_FLAG
column.description: True, if an SMS needs to be sent for the driver-user when 'Release order' and 'Order cancellation' event happens.

column.name: HOMEBASE_COORD_LAT
column.description: Latitude of the homebase of the truck. Set independently of return_shippingpoint_id. This is typically the garage/over-night parking spot of the truck. Usage: Serves as an input-aid in assignment-editor popup in scheduling screen.

column.name: HOMEBASE_COORD_LON
column.description: Longitute of the homebase of the truck. Set independently of return_shippingpoint_id. This is typically the garage/over-night parking spot of the truck. Usage: Serves as an input-aid in assignment-editor popup in scheduling screen.

column.name: RETURN_SHIPPINGPOINT_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_shippingpoint. The shippingpoint where to return to by default after an order has been delivered, also called 'home plant' of the truck. Used in scheduling screen when creating the assignment: If set, take this as the destintion of the return assignment part (tlgnc_assignment_part.shippingpoint_id). If not set, return to the start point of the order, i.e. tlgnc_order.shippingpoint_id.

column.name: RFIDOBJECT_ID
column.description: The ID which is used to associate this object (truck) with RFID tags. An RFID object can have several RFID tags.

column.name: ITRACK_TARGET_ID
column.description: External ID of the truck in the ITrack external system. Might change if the truck is sold to a different carrier.

column.name: ITRACK_AVAILABLE_FLAG
column.description: Set if the truck is equipped with iTrack. If set the order gets to Shipping status after loading.
